# Baseball
Welcome to Baseball

Explore the history of Major League Baseball through data. This site uses the Lahman database to uncover stories, trends, and insights from more than a century of baseball history.

This site explores the history of Major League Baseball through the
Lahman database, a record of every team and player season since 1871.

The **Home runs** page starts with a puzzle: total home runs seem to
collapse in 1981, 1994, and 2020. The collapse is an illusion of
shortened seasons — measured per game, those years are ordinary, and
the rate instead reveals baseball's changing offensive eras. The
**Sluggers** page looks at career home run leaders and shows how many
of baseball's biggest power hitters emerged during the high-offense
era.

Use the analysis pages in the navbar to explore the data and see how
the numbers reveal changes in Major League Baseball over time.
